columns.label: G
columns.help: Games played within the selected filters.

columns.label: Targets
columns.help: Passes thrown to the player, caught or not.

columns.label: Share
columns.help: The player's share of his team's targets in the selected games.

columns.label: ADOT
columns.help: Average depth of target: how far past the line of scrimmage the player was targeted. Needs full play descriptions.

columns.label: YAC
columns.help: Yards gained after the catch. Needs full play descriptions.

columns.label: EPA/Target
columns.help: EPA per target. Expected points added: how much a play changed the offense's expected points, based on down, distance and field position before and after it.
